evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'This should take about five to ten minutes every time that will be able to build you an accurate quote you can depend on, sounds good.' — rushed past without a real wait for affirmation; customer said 'Yeah, sounds great' but rep had already moved into 'Do you have any concerns' before confirming the framing was accepted.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: 'Drake Pate' ✓ | Moving day: 'October 23rd to October 26th' ✓ | Route: 'Austin to Dallas' ✓ | Size: '1100 square foot' ✓ — all four gathered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call today?' but only after already launching into moving day availability. Should have asked before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No, not really just wanting to kind of get a good quote and see if the dates that I need are available.' No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns raised, so N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house) ✓ | Stories (2, main on first floor) ✓ | Bedrooms (2) ✓ | Walk distance (10 feet) ✓ | Additional rooms (none) ✓ | Special considerations (glass desk, two TVs, grill, furniture, outdoor patio items) ✓ | Additional stops (Dallas destination gathered with full details: 2800 sq ft, 3-story townhome, access concerns noted) ✓ — all seven covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asked 'do you need help in packing?' and customer declined. ✓
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep stated 'a typical number of boxes based on your home size is 35 to 45 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer responded lower end 25–30. ✓
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided range anchored to home size (1100 sq ft typical 4–6 hours locally) and personalized it to the customer's situation: two-story pickup, three-story destination, 3+ hours away, split across two days. Gave specific estimate: 6.5–7.5 hours day one, 2.5–3.5 hours day two, total $3,599. Full anchoring and personalization present.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee ($1056) ✓ | Overnight fee ($240) ✓ | Minimum 2.5 hours with 15-minute increments ✓ | 'No hidden fees of any type' ✓ | All disclosed upfront before customer asked. Framing complete.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moved from the estimate directly into explaining the two-day split and timing without asking if the estimate felt fair or holding silence for a response.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep stated 'if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill' with discount framing clear. Full delivery.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep stated 'we have no worry damage coverage included on the early weight that you're paying us we will provide up to 2000 dollars per move that is to repair, replace' — covers $2,000 and 'included' messaging. No explicit 'no deductible / no fine print' framing stated, but 'included' strongly implies no add-on. Scoring as full given the inclusion clarity, though the deductible/fine-print framing was omitted.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep did not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' after the Two Promises section. No closure check performed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or a genuine equivalent. Moved straight to 'I just wanted to let you know that we can be able to book your spot' and then 'I just wanted to, to check if you want us, if you want us to help you with your upcoming move.' — the explicit ask, not a final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' before the ask.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asked 'if you want us, if you want us to help you with your upcoming move.' Plain, no softened out. ✓
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Rep stated 'There's no deposit required, no recent securing your spot' — rate lock (deposit-free booking) mentioned. ✓
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Customer declined the booking ('Honestly, probably not, I had a prior quote of around $2,800... I'll probably be going with them'). No booking details confirmed because customer rejected the ask. No date, phone, arrival window, crew size, or notes finalized.

top_strength: Thorough logistics probing across both pickup and destination, including special items, access concerns, and realistic time splits — the rep gathered everything needed for an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Ask 'Does that feel fair?' after presenting the estimate and hold silence for a genuine response before moving into Two Promises — this is the single highest-friction conversion moment in the call.
